Definition: the nape or back of the neck (as declining); hence, the back generally (whether literal or figurative)
BiblicalUsage: 1) neck, back of the neck, back; 1a) back of the neck; 1a1) of fleeing foe; 1a2) of apostasy (fig.); 1b) stiff of neck, obstinate (fig.)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
